name: dsh-image-studio
description: Image generation studio for DeepSeek Harness — a gallery plus a workbench that switches between text-to-image, image-to-image and a local ComfyUI workflow, previews a multi-image batch, picks the model from the service's own catalog and the workflow from the user's own ComfyUI, calls OpenAI-compatible, Google, Seedream, DashScope, xAI or Zhipu image APIs directly, exposes the ComfyUI run to the conversation as a tool that can hand the produced picture back to the model, and keeps every credential in the host.

scripts.test: node build.mjs --check && node test-image-api.mjs && node test-studio-model.mjs && node test-client.mjs && node test-auth.mjs && node test-host.mjs && node test-tool.mjs && node test-bridge.mjs && node test-bridge-route.mjs
